description: This file contains functions for managing and querying subagent run records, including session start times, runtime calculations, status resolution, and retrieval of subagent runs based on session keys.

methods.name: resolveSubagentSessionStartedAt
methods.description: Resolves the session start time from a subagent run record, prioritizing sessionStartedAt, then startedAt, then createdAt.

methods.name: getSubagentSessionStartedAt
methods.description: Public function that returns the session start time for a given subagent run record, handling null or undefined inputs.

methods.name: getSubagentSessionRuntimeMs
methods.description: Calculates the total runtime in milliseconds for a subagent session, considering accumulated runtime and current run duration.

methods.name: resolveSubagentSessionStatus
methods.description: Determines the current status of a subagent session based on its end time, reason, and outcome.

methods.name: listSubagentRunsForController
methods.description: Lists all subagent runs associated with a specific controller session key.

methods.name: countActiveDescendantRuns
methods.description: Counts the number of active descendant runs from a root session key.

methods.name: listDescendantRunsForRequester
methods.description: Lists descendant runs for a requester identified by a root session key.

methods.name: getSubagentRunByChildSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent subagent run record associated with a specific child session key, active or ended.

methods.name: getSessionDisplaySubagentRunByChildSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the latest subagent run record for a child session key, prioritizing in-memory data, with fallback to stored data.

methods.name: getLatestSubagentRunByChildSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the latest subagent run record for a child session key based on creation time.
